notes.title: Mini-update #1: Balancing
notes.content:
After receiving feedback from the players, we make the first changes

List of changes:

 Killing sharks now requires more shots at them
 Local residents came to the sharks’ aid, be careful (More opponents)
 Some holes in the mountains have been closed
 Minor fixes


Leave your feedback so we can improve the game together with you!
